name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine: Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia
summary: FEWS NET assesses risk of Famine in Sudan, South Sudan and Somalia; no area classified as Famine as of 11 Nov
state: FEWS NET's East Africa outlook to January 2027 assesses a credible risk of Famine in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling in Sudan, four counties of Jonglei and Upper Nile in South Sudan, and agropastoral and riverine areas of Somalia. It says Famine would occur if conflict or sieges cut populations off from food, or in Somalia after a third poor harvest. No area is classified as Famine (IPC Phase 5) as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Risk of famine tends to bring urgent UN appeals and displacement towards neighbouring countries. WFP, UNICEF and the IPC publish the official assessments.
rubric_hit: Watch: FEWS NET 'risk of Famine' alerts in Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia; no confirmed IPC Phase 5 (Alert line)

sources.title: FEWS NET — East Africa Food Security Outlook, June 2026 to January 2027

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
